본 연구의 목적은 초·중등 교육정보화 수준을 측정하기 위한 초·중등 교육정보화 지표를 개발하는 것이다. 본 연구는 이 목적을 달성하기 위해, 교육정보화 및 정보화 지표 개발 관련 국내외 문헌연구, 교육정보화 관련 전문가 회의, 초·중등 학교 현장 방문 등을 통해 잠정적인 지표 항목을 도출하였다. 이러한 지표 항목들의 타당성은 교육정보화 관련 전문가를 대상으로 한 설문조사와 239개교의 초·중등학교를 대상으로 한 모의 조사를 통해 확인되었다.
본 연구를 통해 확정된 교육정보화 지표는 3개 영역, 7개 소항목, 43개 구체적인 지표로 구성되어 있다. 이 교육정보화 지표별 구체적인 수치를 수집하기 위한 산출식과 수집된 자료를 통해 교육정보화 지수를 계산하는 방식을 제시하였다.

The purpose of this study was to develop indicators for information and communication technology(ICT) use in elementary and secondary education. The development of the indicators is one of 10 major tasks included in a comprehensive plan on ICT use in education, prepared in 2001 by the Ministry of Education, Korea.
The study was intended to explore on definitions of ICT use in education, indicators for ICT use in elementary and secondary education, illustration of utilizing the indicators, and an analysis of differences among schools on the indicators. The scope of this study was limited 2001 in time and four categories were used to classify the schools, which were educational districts(16), school type(private and public), school size(~12, 13~35, 36~), school levels(elementary, middle, general, industrial).
Based on the data, 43 indicators for ICT use in elementary and secondary education were developed. In addition, this study suggested a survey forms to collect data and an equation for each indicator in order to calculate an index from the data. While validating the indicators using data collected from a survey, this study illustrated how to use indicators in order to evaluate the status of ICT use in elementary and secondary school, and differences of the level of ICT use among schools. The indicators developed in the study were presented in a table.
Based on the results mentioned before, the followings were suggested in order to facilitate the use of ICT use in education, and utilizing the indicators developed in the study for teaching and learning: 1) focusing on utilizing web environment for learning, 2) secify information regarding the current usage of homepage, 3) revise school website as a portal site for their members.
